compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main]: re-invocation on a branch with an open PR1 (no --resume) -> duplicate staged ref + duplicate PR1
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## 2. Incident Overview

**Scenario Type:** User-flagged workflow defect (surfaced this session).

### Expected Behavior
Re-running `merge-to-main.sh` on a source branch that already has an open PR1 (source -> staged-*) should DETECT that open PR and iterate on it (re-push the head so review-sub-pr re-runs; advance to PR2 once PR1 merges), regardless of whether `--resume` was passed. The resumable state should be auto-detected.

### Actual Behavior
A bare re-invocation (no `--resume`) skips all existing-PR detection and mints a NEW staged-* ref (name embeds HEAD-sha + timestamp, always unique) + a NEW PR1 each time. Observed this session: #553 -> #554 -> #555, same source branch `fix/fp-recovery-guidance`, three different staged bases, three full CI re-runs. Documented prior art in the code comment at merge-to-main-pr.sh:2933 (#490/#492, same class).

### Root Cause (pre-investigation hypothesis)
The existing-open-PR detection (`gh pr list --head \$BRANCH --state open` at merge-to-main-pr.sh:2936) and the advance-to-PR2 logic (line 2893) are BOTH gated behind `if [[ \${_RESUME:-0} -eq 1 ]]`. Detection should run unconditionally; `--resume` should remain an optional fast-path, not a precondition.

### Constraints
- The version-bump phase (_phase_source_branch_version_bump) must not double-bump when reusing an existing PR1.
- Fail-safe: any gh/git uncertainty must default to the safe path (do not advance / do not reuse a wrong PR), preserving the existing `_resume_should_advance_to_staged` conservatism.

### Affected file
plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (+ merge-helpers.sh state functions if relevant)

**code_version:** 203992e9d9e7d250a113c446c84ce4922fbe96be

comments.body: Classification: behavioral (shell control-flow defect in merge-to-main-pr.sh, not mechanical/llm-behavioral). Score: severity=1 (functional friction: wasted CI + PR clutter, workflow still completes), complexity=1 (single file, non-obvious — interacts with --resume state machine + version-bump phase), environment=0 (reproducible locally/observed this session), intermittent=0 (deterministic). Total=2 -> BASIC investigation tier.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: INVESTIGATION (BASIC, confirmed high-confidence): Root cause = TWO detection blocks both gated behind `if [[ ${_RESUME:-0} -eq 1 ]]`: (a) advance-to-PR2 at merge-to-main-pr.sh:2893 (reads staged_branch from state file, re-points BRANCH so _phase_staged_intermediate skips and PR2 opens); (b) GitHub-side open-PR fallback at :2915 (gh pr list --head BRANCH --state open -> populates _RESUME_STATE_PR_URL -> skips _check_duplicate_pr + _phase_merge to resume into the existing open PR). Bare re-invocation sets _RESUME=0 (line 37) so BOTH skip. Proposed fix: remove the `[[ ${_RESUME:-0} -eq 1 ]] &&` prefix from both conditionals so detection runs unconditionally; --resume becomes an optional fast-path. Fail-safe preserved (_resume_should_advance_to_staged defaults to no-advance on gh/git uncertainty; absent/stale state file -> empty staged_branch -> block no-ops). Double-bump guard (lines 620-632, HEAD-subject check) unaffected. NUANCE: this session's repro was scenario B (PR1 open + review-sub-pr failed -> I closed+recreated). Un-gating :2915 is what makes scenario B iterate-in-place. OPEN VERIFICATION before implementing: (1) enumerate EVERY _RESUME reference to confirm 2893/2915 are the only detection gates and no consume-path step (skip _check_duplicate_pr / _phase_merge / re-wait for PR1 checks) is separately _RESUME-gated; (2) confirm the un-gated open-PR path re-waits for PR1's (re-running) review-sub-pr before advancing, not skip-to-PR2-unreviewed.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: CONSUME-PATH VERIFICATION (resolves the open question): Traced merge-to-main-pr.sh:2946-3014. When _RESUME_STATE_PR_URL is set (the :2915 open-PR detection), the script skips _check_duplicate_pr (:2954) AND _phase_staged_intermediate+_phase_merge ENTIRELY (:2969-2975), jumping to final-PR polling (:3002+). That is correct only when the recorded pr_url is the FINAL promotion PR (the original b0ad-69ee resume use case). For an OPEN PR1 (source->staged, e.g. review failed), un-gating :2915 would make a bare re-run poll PR1 as terminal and never create PR2 -> incomplete promotion. CONCLUSION: the investigator's 'un-gate BOTH 2893 and 2915' is NOT safe for :2915. REVISED MINIMAL FIX (narrower than investigation proposal): un-gate ONLY :2893 (advance-to-PR2 when PR1 merged + staged exists) -> fixes the documented duplicate-PR-on-bare-reinvocation (#490/#492 scenario A). For scenario B (open PR1), keep _check_duplicate_pr's exit-1 but make its message POSITIVE (push fix to the branch; the queued auto-merge re-evaluates; re-run advances to PR2 once PR1 merges). Full iterate-on-open-PR is deferred to MQ-4 (which retires the staged-*/PR1/PR2 two-tier entirely). This narrowed scope is a revision of the investigation's proposed fix and will be opus-reviewed before implementation per project directive.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: SCOPE EXPANSION (critical, from a live stuck-session report + b7bf-c3b9 closed bug): un-gating :2893 NAIVELY would AMPLIFY the --resume state-loss class. Evidence: a concurrent session ran merge-to-main --resume; the advance-to-PR2 guard (_resume_should_advance_to_staged: pr1_open=0 AND staged_exists=1) returned TRUE and restored BRANCH to an EMPTY staged branch sitting at main (no session work), claiming 'PR1 merged' when the work was never on main. The version bump was lost. b7bf-c3b9 (closed P2) is the same family: --resume's GitHub fallback (gh pr list --head BRANCH) resolved the WRONG PR — the legacy umbrella draft PR (worktree->main, e.g. #534) that sprint Phase A creates (ticket 1f5f). So the umbrella draft PR (1f5f) and the resume advance/fallback logic (73b5/b7bf) are ONE system. REVISED BUNDLED FIX (folding 1f5f + 73b5, pre-MQ): (1) HARDEN _resume_should_advance_to_staged to require the staged branch actually contains the work (commits ahead of main / session SHA reachable), not merely exists — fixes the empty-staged advance; (2) THEN un-gate :2893 (safe once hardened); (3) HARDEN the resume open-PR fallback (:2936) to EXCLUDE base=main umbrella PRs (only resolve staged-* base) so it never grabs the umbrella PR; (4) 1f5f: stop the umbrella draft PR from masquerading as session->main (or relocate the GitHubPRDefenseStore substrate); (5) positive scenario-B message. This is interrelated but bounded to merge-to-main-pr.sh + create-sprint-draft-pr.sh. Scope grew beyond BASIC -> needs a combined INTERMEDIATE investigation + opus design review before implementation.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FIX IMPLEMENTED + committed (78163b1407): Fix A (un-gate advance-to-PR2), Fix B (predicate hardened with staged_work_count), Fix C (resume fallback filters to staged-* base). RED->GREEN verified (predicate 12/12, static-contract 6/6, zero regressions across 31 merge-to-main test files). Opus-designed + opus-reviewed.
